newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Emerson Radio mulls buying Pam&Frank - paper.
newsitem.headline: Emerson Radio mulls buying Pam&Frank - paper.

text.p: Emerson Radio Corp is in negotiations to buy financially distressed sports bag maker Pam & Frank International Holdings Ltd, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Friday.

The newspaper quoted banking sources as saying U.S.-listed Emerson Radio has appointed Ernst & Young to do a valuation report on the assets of Pam & Frank, which was expected to take some months to complete.
Pam & Frank is seen owing HK$400-500 million to its bankers, the paper said.
Officials at Emerson Radio's Hong Kong unit declined to comment, while Pam & Frank officials were not immediately available.
Pam & Frank earlier this week reported a net loss of HK$368.72 million for the year ended June 30, 1996, against HK$42.75 million profit in the year earlier period.
In August, the company said it was in serious financial distress and would discuss a debt restructuring plan with bankers, as well as pursuing asset disposals and cost reduction.
